correlation_spike_stress.scenario: All open holdings hit correlated 1.0x stop-loss simultaneously during market shock
correlation_spike_stress.mitigation: Pairwise 60D correlation gate (rho <= 0.72) + Drawdown Governor (0.65x/0.45x scaling)

sector_crash_stress.scenario: -20% instantaneous crash in portfolio's largest sector allocation
sector_crash_stress.mitigation: Hard 28% sector notional cap & max 2 positions per sector limit
